full: Automatic Meter Reading (AMR) Device for Gas Meters
tagline: Battery-powered LoRaWAN gas-meter AMR with built-in pulse detection, tamper alerts and 5+ year battery life.
meta_desc: Nebulae Gas Meter AMR — wireless battery-based LoRaWAN/Sigfox device for diaphragm gas meters: Hall-effect pulse detection, tamper and magnetic alerts, ~10 km range, 5+ year battery, IP65, -20 to +85 C.
desc: Nebulae AMR is a wireless, battery-based device for live reporting of gas consumption data, with a built-in pulse detector that installs on existing diaphragm gas meters. It provides alerts on tamper detection (device removal) and magnetic interference, and offers long range (about 10 km) through a single LoRaWAN gateway/DCU connected to Nebulae or another service provider's LoRaWAN server.

overview: Nebulae AMR is a unique wireless, battery-based device for live reporting of gas consumption data, with a built-in pulse detector that can be installed on existing diaphragm gas meters. It provides alerts on tamper detection on device removal and magnetic interference.

It offers long range (about 10 km) using multipoint communication with a single LoRaWAN gateway/DCU connected to Nebulae or another service provider's LoRaWAN server, which makes it a cost-effective solution for utility companies. It is built on the NebuLink Node NLN500a, the smallest STM32WL based LoRaWAN module.

Retrofit is simple: hook the device on with a screw or cable tie, and it sends live data at pre-configured intervals with no configuration. Meter reading is based on the incremental pulse count from the meter using Hall-effect technology; the sensor stays always on and wakes the device from sleep on pulse detection. Dial speeds up to 6 seconds per revolution are supported on G1.6 domestic meters (Qmax = 2.5 m³/h).
overview_note: * Customization is supported based on requirements.

why.d: Installs on existing meters with a screw or cable tie; no configuration required.
Device-removal and magnetic-interference alerts; other operations can be disabled on tamper (configurable).
5+ years with deep sleep, from a replaceable D-cell lithium thionyl chloride battery.
Multipoint communication to one gateway/DCU over up to 10 km line of sight.
Client–server model removes walk-by or drive-by reading.

rows: Any diaphragm magnetic / inductive pulse-based gas meter
Incremental pulse count using Hall-effect technology; sensor always on and wakes the device on pulse
G1.6 domestic meters with Qmax = 2.5 m³/h: 6 seconds / revolution
Fixed or configurable reporting interval; sends the sum of pulse counts (total gas consumption count) plus battery, magnetic-interference and tamper status
~10 km (line of sight), multipoint with a single LoRaWAN gateway/DCU
Non-rechargeable D-cell lithium thionyl chloride (replaceable); 5+ years with deep sleep technology
Retrofit with screw or cable-tie hook option
